title: Riot Squad Pod Liq Grape Strawberry 80ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pod Liq Shortfills are the latest innovation from Riot Squad that let you enjoy the long-lasting value and great flavours of Shortfill E-liquids in a huge variety of vape kits that use higher-resistance coils. Pod Liq’s unique 60%PG/40%VG ratio is tailor-made for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping with its perfect balance of vapour, flavour and throat hit. Available in 120ml bottles with 80ml of 0mg E-liquid, you have the freedom to tailor your nicotine content with the use of Nicotine Shots . Two x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 100ml of 3mg 50/50 E-liquid. While Four x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 120ml of 6mg 50/50 E-liquid. Step into a realm of unparalleled flavour with Riot Squad's Grape Strawberry 60/40 Shortfill E-liquid. When you think of fruit pairings that are a match made in heaven, grape and strawberry are certainly up there. This meticulously crafted e-liquid brings together the voluptuous sweetness of grape with the juicy, sun-kissed essence of strawberries. The flavour profile is a celebration of fruitiness that bursts with complexity yet retains an elegant simplicity. Each inhale greets you with the succulent, sugary richness of ripe grapes, immediately followed by an exhale that's awash with the delightful tang of strawberries, leaving an aftertaste that lingers in a satisfyingly sweet manner. Grape Strawberry isn't just an e-liquid; it's a journey through the orchards and vineyards, capturing the very best of what nature has to offer. Each puff is akin to a bite of a fresh fruit salad, lovingly prepared with the ripest of ingredients. Perfect for vapers who revel in an authentically fruit-forward experience, Grape Strawberry sets the bar incredibly high for what a fruit-flavoured blend should be.
